# Mikhail Kirs Portfolio

> Portfolio of Mikhail Kirs, a London, Ontario-based video content creator working across personal brand content, local business storytelling, and long-form visual storytelling.

This is the English-language public portfolio of Mikhail Kirs. The primary pages below contain the full project descriptions as static HTML.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.mikhailkirs.com/): Portfolio overview, selected work, biography, education, and contact links.
- [Personal Brand Content](https://www.mikhailkirs.com/personal-brand.html): Personal brand framework and a 2026 London, Ontario municipal campaign video case study.
- [Local Business Storytelling](https://www.mikhailkirs.com/project-forest-city.html): Forest City Spotlight, a local business video storytelling series in London, Ontario.
- [Long-Form Visual Storytelling](https://www.mikhailkirs.com/project-city-storytelling.html): A two-part London Winter 2024 personal film project built around research, scripting, filming, editing, history, and everyday city life.
